source: revalidated real PCB1 CSV and DPS readback; no synthetic traces

static.model_scope: Empirical compact fit per measured gate level; not a MOS intrinsic parameter model.
static.validation: Each held-out point is predicted using the other six points of the same curve.

notes: Each channel is sampled sequentially, not simultaneously.
VG and VD traces retain raw ADC voltages; current subtracts a gate-dependent matched OFF baseline.
Platform metrics use source-zero correction, exclude transition rows and a 5 ms edge guard.
Low-frequency acquisition characterizes the whole instrument; no intrinsic MOS switching time claim.

threshold_trend_fit.method: linear sqrt(ID) versus VGS for ID >= 0.2 mA
threshold_trend_fit.scope: Finite VDS=0.5 V, nominal current scale and limited gate range: trend proxy only, not datasheet VGS(th).
